name: Nha Trang Night Run Sanest, Sanvinest – BKH 2026
short_description: Nha Trang Night Run Sanest, Sanvinest – BKH is on Saturday 12 December 2026 at 2/4 Square in Nha Trang, over 5 km, 10 km and 21 km, with an evening start.
ai_summary: Nha Trang Night Run Sanest, Sanvinest – BKH 2026 is the second edition of this night race, held on Saturday 12 December 2026 from 2/4 Square, 46 Tran Phu, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa. The 21 km starts at 19:00, the 10 km at 19:30 and the 5 km at 20:00, on a road course along the Nha Trang seafront. Part of the proceeds funds eye surgery for poor patients, according to the event page.

core_facts.organizer: Bao Khanh Hoa (Khanh Hoa Newspaper), operated by VietRace365

faqs.question: What time does Nha Trang Night Run Sanest, Sanvinest – BKH 2026 start?
faqs.answer: The published schedule has the 21 km starting at 19:00 on Saturday 12 December 2026, the 10 km at 19:30 and the 5 km at 20:00. The 21 km course closes at 22:30, giving about 3 hours 30 minutes. The organiser notes the schedule may change.

faqs.question: When is kit collection for Nha Trang Night Run Sanest, Sanvinest – BKH 2026?
faqs.answer: Race kits are handed out on race day itself, from 08:00 to 17:00 at 2/4 Square. The opening ceremony runs from 16:00 to 18:00 and the bag drop opens at 18:00. Awards follow after the 10 km course closes at 22:00.
